name: Rasguido doble
label: RASG DOBLE
source: Casado, Figueras, Sturla (FBA-UNLP) 2021 apunte 4 via Adriani & Schinca (JIDAP 2022): 4/4 grouped 3+3+2 eighths; es.wikipedia Rasguido doble guitar staff (bordonas on eighths 1, 4, 7); tempo a practice default

sources.title: Adriani & Schinca, Rasguido doble: nuevas texturas y sonoridades (FBA-UNLP, JIDAP 2022), citing Casado, Figueras & Sturla 2021, Musica del Litoral, Produccion y analisis II, apunte 4, p. 4
sources.shows: Prose: the genre's identifying trait is the accompaniment's grouping 3 3 2 at the eighth-note level in 4/4, i.e. group onsets on eighths 1, 4, 7

sources.title: Rasguido doble, Spanish Wikipedia, section 'Caracteristicas del rasguido en guitarra' (staff image Rasguido_doble_music_sheet.jpg)
sources.shows: 4/4 in eighths: bordonas (low) on eighths 1 (accent), 4 and 7 (accent); primas (high) on 2 and 5; apagado x on 3, 6 and 8. Only the low 3+3+2 layer is shipped, the one both sources agree on
